thread:
Leah: Quick heads-up — Lyra QBR is next Wednesday. Need token econ section, 90-day spend forecast, and any budget alerts we should surface to the account team. Who can own the numbers? :eyes:

Omar: I can own the forecast. I'll pull 90/60/30 day slices and a conservative vs expected burn. Will need current onboarding numbers from Carlos. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Carlos: Onboarding status for Lyra: 3 of 5 integrations live, trial is expanding to 20 seats this week. Seed traffic shows spike patterns at 10am PST. Current observed tokens/day ~1.2M.

Priya: I'll run enablement outreach for the power users and ask for a short list of eval prompts — helps tie quality regressions to spend. Also can we get a simple one-pager for finance to explain token buckets?

Omar: Agree on the one-pager. I'll draft the token econ explainer and include simple math: cost per 1k tokens, projected monthly burn under low/med/high usage.

billing-bot: ALERT: account Lyra crossed 70% of monthly soft threshold (2,500,000 tokens). Details:
```
account: LYRA
period: 30d
tokens_used: 1,950,342
soft_threshold: 2,500,000
projected_month_end: 2,800,000
```

Leah: Nice, thanks @billing-bot / @Omar — that projection is the priority. Can we add an action item to propose one mitigation: temporary rate-limit or model downgrade path for non-critical routes? Need something we can show in QBR. :memo:

Carlos: We can throttle background embed jobs and route low-priority calls to a smaller model. I can list route names today. Also noting the KV cache hit rate is 62% which gives us room for prefix caching improvements.

Priya: For enablement, I'll assemble customer-facing guidance on how to reduce exploration traffic (suggest seed prompts + test harness). Will include a simple checklist: role-based training, prompt set reduction, rate-limit opt-in.

Omar: I'll post the forecast spreadsheet in #cs-assets by EOD. Columns: date, daily_tokens, avg_cost_per_1k, cumulative_cost, mitigation_notes. Link: https://tiny.redwood/lyra-qbr-forecast (will update live)

Leah: Perfect. Final ask: please drop a 1-slide summary (numbers + mitigation) in this thread by tomorrow 10am PT. I'll compile into the QBR deck. :clock1: 

Carlos: Adding route list + cache improvement bullets by 9am PT tomorrow.

billing-bot: NOTE: automated notification created a billing ticket #BILL-4829 for Lyra; link in the ticket will contain detailed daily breakdowns.

Priya: I'll coordinate with Solutions to draft the customer-facing note. tagging @Omar for cost numbers.

Leah: Thanks team. Short and actionable — exactly what execs want. :thumbsup:

Omar: On it. I'll ping when spreadsheet is live.

(Reaction summary: several :thumbsup:, one :eyes: on the billing-bot alert)
